name: micro-scale-fade
title: Micro Scale Fade
description: A calm, tiny scale pop for subtle premium polish on labels and headings.
useWhen: A label, subheading or supporting text needs a polished entrance that does not draw attention.
A single block of text should appear in a neutral way that suits product, SaaS or corporate video.
avoidWhen: The reveal should be the hero moment: use kinetic-center-build or per-character-rise.
The text must also exit: this block is entrance-only.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Text
variables.description: Text that fades and scales in.

variables.label: Scale from
variables.description: Starting scale the text grows from as it fades in.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Maximum text size in pixels. Longer text shrinks to fit the frame.
